Where is the main police station on Koh Samui? | Koh Samui Police Station, the island's district station, is on the west coast in the Nathon area, phone +66 77 421 097. Bo Phut Police Station covers the busy north and east, including Chaweng. For anything urgent, call 191 or 1155 rather than driving to a station.
What is the police emergency number in Thailand? | 191 for the police and 1155 for the English-speaking Tourist Police, both 24 hours. For an ambulance call 1669, and for fire 199.
Should I report a theft to the police or the Tourist Police? | Start with the Tourist Police on 1155: they speak English, can take the report or tell you which station to visit, and help with translation. The regular police station for the area where the theft happened handles the case itself.
How do I pay a traffic fine on Koh Samui? | The officer usually writes a ticket that you pay at the police station named on it, or on the spot to an authorised officer, and you should always get an official receipt. If someone asks for cash without a ticket or receipt, offer to pay at the station and call 1155 if unsure.
What should I do if I'm arrested in Thailand? | Stay calm, ask for your embassy to be informed, don't sign anything you can't read, and ask for an interpreter and a lawyer. Consular staff can't get you released but can check on your welfare and give you a list of local lawyers.
Is there a police station in Chaweng? | Chaweng falls under Bo Phut Police Station, and small police boxes stand in the busiest streets. The Tourist Police patrol Chaweng regularly; call 1155 and they will come to you or tell you where to go.
Do I need a police report for a lost phone? | Yes, if you want to claim on travel insurance. Report it within 24 hours, include the phone's IMEI number and approximate value, and ask for an English summary of the Thai report.
Can the Tourist Police help with a jet-ski damage dispute? | Yes, it is one of the most common cases they handle on Samui. Call 1155, show your photos and contract, don't pay under pressure, and never leave your passport as a deposit.
